ios.desc:
Never lose track of your time again. The Toggl Track Lockscreen Widget brings your active timers directly to your iPhone lock screen, so you can see what you're working on and stop timers instantly—all without opening the app.

** Key Features:**

 **Real-Time Updates**
Your widgets automatically refresh in real-time to show your latest time entries. See your current timer, project name, and duration without ever opening the Toggl app.

**Quick Stop Timer**
Stop your active timer directly from the widget with a single tap. No need to open the app—just tap and you're done.

**Beautiful Design**
Clean, modern iOS design that looks great on your lock screen. The widget seamlessly integrates with your iOS aesthetic.

**Secure & Private**
Your Toggl API token is stored securely on your device (iOS Keychain) and, an encrypted copy is securely stored on our servers.

**Perfect For:**
• Freelancers tracking billable hours
• Teams managing project time
• Anyone who wants to stay on top of their time tracking
• Productivity enthusiasts who love widgets

**How It Works:**

1. Log in with your Toggl Track credentials
2. Start your timer in Toggl Track
3. See your active timers at a glance
4. Stop timers with a single tap

**Requirements:**
• Toggl Track account
• iOS 17.0 or later
• Internet connection for updates

Start tracking your time more efficiently today. Download the Toggl Lockscreen Widget and take control of your productivity.
